moments.action: At the party the young American in the open white shirt trades talk with his friend in cornrows while women dance behind them; the friend leans in laughing and by the last shot the American is grinning back.
His attention slides off his friend to a knot of partygoers by the doorway; he pushes out through the crowd and passes a long-haired man in a pale jacket sipping a blue drink.
moments.censor_note: party women in low-cut and lingerie-style tops at the frame edges, roughly a quarter of frame, not the subject

moments.action: He follows two women out of the doorway into the workshop beyond, and the camera pans off them along a red car raised on a blue lift to an orange chopper parked on the shop floor.
moments.censor_note: woman in a pink lace camisole in the foreground, about a third of frame, no nudity

moments.action: Standing among the drinkers he tips his head back to take the place in; the camera holds on the orange chopper, and his stunned stare has turned into a grin by the cut.

The tour of the garage continues: a silver coupe held up on a rotary lift against the lit Tokyo street outside, then a tilt up to a mezzanine where people lounge on sofas and eat at a table above the shop.
He walks past a red Evo, stops and turns back to it; a close-up holds his face with the grin gone, and the car is shown head-on, squared up on the lift.

The long-haired man, flanked by two women pouring champagne, talks across the shop while the American walks the length of the red car; by the last close-ups the American has stopped smiling and stares back hard.
moments.censor_note: the two women in low-cut party tops beside him, about a third of frame, no nudity

moments.action: Hard cut from night to daylight: an aerial over Tokyo's industrial waterfront, then hands working a fishing reel and a wide of two men settled on a concrete quay with the city across the water.
A red car slews past a parked trailer in a cloud of dust behind them; the two fishermen break off and turn toward the noise, and an overhead shot catches the car sliding across the empty yard.
